We've got posh pads in cities just a hop, skip and a jump away this week. South Beach's legendary Shore Club is on prime
party real estate and has a vast rooftop spa, Nobu restaurant, and the sceney Skybar. A block off the Strip, the Signature
at MGM Grand delivers a tranquil (read: non-gaming) take on Vegas with apartment-like suites and cabana-lined pools,
while New York's elegant Helmsley Park Lane has jaw-dropping views of Central Park South. The fun continues over the
pond: Mini Cooper cars are among the amenities on offer at Hotel Miramar, a sleek sleep in Barcelona's leafy MontjuIc
quarter, and Paris' Hotel de Crillon has a bull's eye location and white glove service. Sweet retreats, indeed.

        Hotel Miramar is one of Barcelona's most attractive hotels, fittingly located in the city's most picturesque, tree-
lined quarter. It's the choice for travelers who prefer a relaxing, out-of-the-way atmosphere along with convenient,
modern extras like a spa, indoor and outdoor swimming pools and the use of the hotel's Mini Coopers. The hotel's
elevated position affords views across Barcelona's rooftops and out to the Mediterranean, but the city action along La
Rambla is just a short drive away.

Central Park South lies just beyond.
